summary.intent: Debug and fix a bug where the FUSE-mounted desktop folder showed stale file content after editing a file in the web UI, then add cross-client sync E2E tests to prevent regression.
summary.outcome: Root cause identified and fixed in inode.rs (populate_folder never re-resolved already-resolved files when modified_at changed), web UI fixed to republish folder metadata on file edits, cross-client sync E2E test scripts added, and all PR review comments resolved across three review rounds.

repo: The FUSE inode table in crates/fuse/src/inode.rs uses a TTL-based refresh cycle (~30s) via drain_refresh_completions + populate_folder; IPNS re-resolution is only triggered for inodes with file_meta_resolved: false

The web UI's useFileOperations.ts was only republishing folder metadata during IPNS key migration, not on normal file edits — meaning the folder FilePointer's modified_at never updated for other clients
Content cache is CID-keyed (content-addressed), so it would return correct data for a new CID — the bug was purely upstream in the stale CID reference

The API client at packages/api-client is code-generated; its dist can become stale relative to the OpenAPI spec, causing false type errors (PublishIpnsDto.publicKey was present in source but missing from stale dist)
IPNS private keys for files are stored encrypted in the FilePointer; the root folder's IPNS keypair is derived via deriveVaultIpnsKeypair(userPrivateKey) in useAuth.ts
Desktop E2E round-trip tests use SDK scripts (packages/sdk-core/scripts/) pointed at a local dev instance; test-round-trip.sh is the existing pattern for cross-component verification
The release-please setup manages versioning across monorepo packages; tags follow both @cipherbox/api-vX.Y.Z and cipher-box-vX.Y.Z conventions

code.finding: populate_folder() preserved existing InodeKind wholesale for file_meta_resolved: true inodes, ignoring modified_at changes from incoming FilePointer metadata
Comparison changed from > to != to handle clock skew — backward clock skew would otherwise leave the inode perpetually stale
updateFolderMetadataAndPublish was only called during IPNS key migration, not after normal file edits — folder FilePointer modified_at never propagated to polling clients

test_populate_folder_resets_resolved_file_on_modified_at_change covers: unchanged modified_at preserves resolved state, newer modified_at resets to unresolved with IPNS name preserved, different IPNS name with newer modified_at clears old key material
Arg parsing used absence check for --new-content; changed to value === undefined to allow empty string as valid new content

workflow: The gsd-debugger subagent pattern (fresh 200k context per investigation) is effective for deep codebase investigations — it found and fixed the root cause including writing a new unit test in one pass
When checking whether a pre-existing type error is your fault, stash changes and typecheck on a clean state before re-applying
Regenerating code-generated clients (pnpm api:generate) can silently fix type errors caused by stale dist artifacts without any source changes needed
1Password SSH agent signing failures cause git commit to fail with no staged-changes loss — files remain staged and commit can be retried after unlocking
Cargo.lock gets phantom version bumps for workspace crates even when Cargo.toml is unchanged; always revert these before committing to avoid noise

friction: 1Password SSH agent wasn't unlocked, causing commit failure mid-session requiring retry
cargo check caused a phantom Cargo.lock diff for cipherbox-fuse that needed manual reversion twice
Three separate rounds of PR review comments (CodeRabbit + GitHub Copilot) required three separate resolve cycles
The web UI folder metadata republish bug was only discovered while writing the E2E test, not during the original debugging — the FUSE fix alone would not have been sufficient
Stale API client dist caused a spurious type error that looked like a real bug until regeneration was attempted
Git branch management was complicated by working across fix/ branch and an orphan branch that needed cleanup
open_items: The cross-client sync E2E test (test-cross-client-sync.sh) requires a running desktop app with FUSE mount — it cannot run in standard CI without additional infrastructure setup
The clock skew fix (!=) now triggers re-resolution even on backward clock skew, which could cause unnecessary IPNS re-fetches; no debounce or rate-limiting exists for this path
The populate_folder identity-change detection compares IPNS names, but if a file is replaced with one that has no IPNS name (edge case), behavior may be undefined
Pre-existing type error in apps/web/src/services/ipns.service.ts was confirmed as pre-existing and left unfixed
The edit-filepointer.mjs SDK script was written but not covered by any automated tests of its own logic
